hints.title: Digit Sum Grouping
hints.text: Group each number from 1 to n by the sum of its decimal digits.

hints.title: Find Group Sizes
hints.text: Count how many numbers fall into each digit sum group.

hints.title: Count Groups with Maximum Size
hints.text: Identify the maximum group size and count how many groups have that maximum size.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building full lists of members per group consumes redundant memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since digit sum for n <= 10^4 is at most 36, a fixed array of size 37 uses O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate extracts digit sums cleanly and tallies group size counts.
